argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$ports=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 17450 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
Write-Output ('PORT17450_LISTENERS='+$ports.Count)
foreach($conn in $ports){
 Write-Output ('PORT17450_PID='+$conn.OwningProcess)
 $p=Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 Write-Output ('PORT17450_PROCESS='+[string]$p.ProcessName)
}
try{$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17450/api/live' -TimeoutSec 2
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_CONTRACT='+$r.contract)
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_READONLY='+$r.readOnly)
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_NO_SEND='+$r.guardrails.noSend)
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_OPEN='+$r.openCount)
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_UNREGISTERED='+$r.unregisteredOpenCount)
 Write-Output ('OBSERVER_ASSIGNMENTS='+@($r.assignments).Count)
}catch{Write-Output ('API_NOT_VERIFIED='+$_.Exception.GetType().Name)}
Write-Output ('SIDECAR_STDOUT_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\WebAIBridge-R68-OBSERVABILITY-20261014-GPT6\R68_VIEWER_17450_STDOUT.log'))
Write-Output ('SIDECAR_STDERR_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\WebAIBridge-R68-OBSERVABILITY-20261014-GPT6\R68_VIEWER_17450_STDERR.log'))
Write-Output 'READ_ONLY_RECONCILIATION_DONE'
